title: Opportunity review outcomes
method: Synthetic review of 20 opportunities. Twelve have verified decisions, giving 60% decision completion. Declined changes count as decisions but not savings. Pending items have no claimed financial outcome.
alt: Opportunity review outcomes. Implemented: 8 opportunities; Declined with evidence: 4 opportunities; Ownership missing: 5 opportunities; Evidence missing: 3 opportunities. Illustrative values.
